data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 写下符文的纸
data.description: 她把一张写满记录的纸放在桌上，正用笔补上最后一个符文。
data.action: writing a rune on a sheet of paper at a desk
data.promptProse: Sitting at a rustic wooden workshop table, Bazett carves careful geometric runes into a polished wooden talisman with a handheld chisel. A brass oil lamp casts clear, warm light across her workspace, illuminating wood shavings and reference sketches.
